description: A free, static-first computer science learning platform with 245 curated topics, 72 live interactive engines, animated interview walkthroughs, and a local-first learning layer with optional account sync.

techStack.ui: React 19, Tailwind CSS, Radix UI, Framer Motion, Lucide
techStack.visualization: Canvas, SVG, D3, Anime.js, Monaco Editor
techStack.database: Optional Postgres for accounts, learning sync, comments, and certificates

routing.note: Canonical topic URLs are rewritten to engine paths. Direct visits to engine paths 308-redirect to the canonical URL.

naming.topicSlug: Stable public topic identifier used by URLs, storage, analytics, and the API
naming.catalogId: Numeric internal id; never used in URLs
naming.enginePath: Top-level engine route segment; currently equal to topicSlug
naming.module: Multi-view curriculum package registered in src/lib/module-registry.ts
naming.subtopicSlug: Section slug inside a curriculum module
naming.crossListedDomains: Extra domains a topic is listed under

principles: Free forever for learning; no paywall on topics, visualizers, or interview prep.
Local-first by default; accounts are optional and only for sync.
Every topic keeps its own learning method and interactions; no forced shared template.
Static-first rendering with SSG for public content.
One authoritative topic-to-engine map; no duplicated naming tables.
